title: Blue Lock Discord Bot Character Database
canon_snapshot: Manga/official-material character data represented for a game database. Club labels marked (NEL) describe the Neo Egoist League context, not a claim about a real-world/current post-NEL contract.
important_notes: All numeric stats, Overall, growth, rarity, effects, levels, roles, and potential are original game-design values—not official Blue Lock ratings.
Canonical biography fields use Unknown where this dataset does not have a reliable official confirmation. Unknown is intentionally not inferred.

Ability type Official term means the label is used in canon; Official description means the trait is expressly described officially; Interpretation means a useful gameplay label derived from depicted play and is not an official name.
Rarity measures collection/event desirability and implementation value, not an absolute canon power ranking.
A missing ability array means no named or sufficiently distinct ability was safely encoded.

overall_formula.range: Every component and Overall is constrained to 0–100.
